headline: Wilmar Shares Slide on Weaker Q3 Earnings and Police Probe
summary: Wilmar shares dropped more than 4% following weaker third-quarter earnings and an Indonesian police investigation into plantation fires on subsidiary land.
why: Wilmar International is a major global agribusiness and palm oil producer whose operational and regulatory hurdles directly affect agricultural commodity supply chains.

impacts.name: Wilmar International
impacts.why: Weakened quarterly earnings combined with legal investigations into plantation assets elevate operational risks, driving shares down.

why_moved: Disappointing third-quarter financial results coupled with news of a police investigation into plantation fires created negative investor sentiment, leading to a sharp share price drop.
